Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents an event with details such as title, description, location, date, and image.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Event entity. The specific format and generation strategy depend on the target database implementation.

description.description: A detailed description of the event.

location.description: The location where the event will take place.

startDate.description: The start date of the event. Can be null if the event doesn't have a specific start date.

endDate.description: The end date of the event. Can be null if the event doesn't have a specific end date.

imageUrl.description: URL of the image illustrating the event. Can be null if no image is available.

params.description: The unique ID of the event.
params.name: eventId

firestore.reasoning: Based on the application proposal, we need a collection to store events. Each document in the `events` collection will represent a single event and will contain the fields defined in the `Event` entity (title, description, location, startDate, endDate, and imageUrl). Since the application supports anonymous authentication in addition to password-based authentication, security rules need to accommodate both authenticated and unauthenticated users.
